chapter.heading: Psalm 134Greetings of Night Watchers.A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Behold, bless
and praise the Lord, all servants of the Lord (priests, Levites),Who stand and serve by night in the house of the Lord. [1 Chr 9:33]

Lift up
your hands to the sanctuaryAnd bless the Lord.

May the
Lord bless you from Zion,He who made heaven and earth.
